question: What smart-contract and layer-2 options exist on or around Hive as of 2026-10-08, how do they custody and reach other chains, and what has been measured?

frame.population: Hive Engine sidechain, Magi/VSC layer-2, HAF and hived itself
frame.exposure: peg accounts, committee keys, bridge repos, on-chain balances
frame.comparator: a pool contract on an EVM chain

item.title: api.hive-engine.com/rpc blockchain, contracts: getLatestBlockInfo, tokens.tokens, witnesses.witnesses and witnesses.params

findings.finding: Sidechain head block 63,539,307 references Hive block 110,602,657: the sidechain is live and follows Hive block by block.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: getLatestBlockInfo: blockNumber 63539307, refHiveBlockNumber 110602657

findings.finding: Pegged tokens: SWAP.HIVE issued by honey-swap (supply field 9007199254740991, circulating 9007199254740934.51); SWAP.HBD issued by graphene-swap, supply 219,175.00902 = circulating 219,175.00902; SWAP.USDT issued by he-nuked, supply 1,161,568.998455, description "DEPRECATED. DO NOT TRADE!"; BEE (Hive Engine token) supply 5,084,208.64, staked 519,883.92.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: tokens.tokens rows

findings.finding: Each sidechain transaction is recorded with sender, contract, action and payload, for example sender scr00ge, contract market, action buy, payload {"symbol":"CHAOS","quantity":"10","price":"6.26031604","isSignedWithActiveKey":true}, with the Hive block it references.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: getLatestBlockInfo transactions[0]

findings.finding: Sidechain consensus parameters: 21 witness slots, 20 top witnesses, 30 approvals per account, witnessSignaturesRequired 13, numberOfApprovedWitnesses 109, totalEnabledApprovalWeight 1,397,241; 28 enabled witnesses (hewitness, tribaldexwitness, actifit-he, kanibot, ph1102.ctp, ...).
findings.exactSourceLanguage: witnesses.params row

findings.finding: Repository is the Hive Engine node software, pushed 2026-10-06, 18 stars; contracts are JavaScript files (tokens, market, marketpools, nft, witnesses, hivepegged, distribution, ...). The SWAP.HIVE buy action sends SWAP.HIVE minus a 0.75% fee (minimum 0.001 HIVE) to the buyer; "SBD not supported" in that action.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: let fee = api.BigNumber(quantityToSend).multipliedBy('0.0075').toFixed(3); ... } else { // SBD not supported }

item.title: vsc-eco/docs: FAQ, Native Asset Mapping, Feeless In-Protocol Transactions, Stablecoin (HBD) as the Base Asset

findings.finding: Mainnet launch date, no token, WASM contracts.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Mainnet has launched March 31st 2025."; "Magi uses WebAssembly (or WASM) to power it's smart contracts."; "No, Magi uses the native Hive tokens for all transactions on the network."

findings.finding: Every liquidity pool is paired with HBD (pools needed grows O(n) rather than O(n^2)).
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Magi employs Hive Backed Dollars (HBD), an algorithmic stablecoin, as the base asset in all liquidity pools."

findings.finding: Resource credits on Magi are tied to HBD held and regenerate about 25% per day.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "They are **tied to the amount of HBD** an account holds."; "regenerates over time at a rate of approximately 25% per day"

findings.finding: Native Asset Mapping: assets from other chains are held in Magi vaults on their home chain, secured by the validator system; Litecoin, Dash and Solana support described as planned.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "The received BTC remains in the Magi vault on the Bitcoin mainnet and is secured by the Magi protocol validator system. ... (Litecoin, Dash, and Solana support is planned"

item.title: vsc-eco/go-vsc-node README and docs (commit 3d4c965f, 2026-10-08): index.md, tss.md, consensus-upgrades.md, magi-lean-audit.md

findings.finding: Architecture: a layer-2 on top of the Hive block stream providing threshold signing, contract execution and bridging; networks vsc-mainnet, vsc-testnet, vsc-devnet; gateway wallet account vsc.gateway (system-config.go lines 304, 407, 499).
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "It implements a layer-2 network on top of the Hive blockchain, providing threshold signing, contract execution, and bridging to external chains."

findings.finding: Committee and keys: tss-lib ECDSA and EdDSA keygen by the current witness committee, reshare on rotation, activation only after a leader posts vsc.tss_commitment to Hive with a verified BLS quorum proof; only the slot leader broadcasts the final Hive custom_json operations.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Only the slot leader is responsible for broadcasting the final Hive custom JSON operations."

findings.finding: Consensus upgrades: the active version is a pure function of the on-chain election; a version floor rises only when at least 80% of committee stake announces it (ConsensusVersionActivationNum/Den 4/5).
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "stake-readiness guard passes (≥ ConsensusVersionActivationNum/Den, default 80%, of committee stake already announces the target)"

findings.finding: The project's own audit dated 2026-04-29 lists, as Critical, that the epoch-boundary settlement handler is effectively disabled (selfID = ""), and, as High, a process-local duplicate-transaction guard that is not consensus-safe.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Critical ... Settlement boundary handler is effectively disabled"; "Duplicate-tx guard is process-local memory, not consensus-state safe"

findings.finding: Bridge components: mapping-bot monitors UTXO chains (BTC, LTC, DASH, DOGE, BCH); zk Ethereum light client: sp1-helios-magi proves beacon-chain finality with SP1 Groth16 and zk-header-verifier (WASM, permissionless submitProof, max 12 headers per transaction, 10,000-block retention) stores headers read by the EVM bridge.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Permissionless proof submission with hash chain verification. Read by the EVM bridge via contracts.read() for trustless deposit/withdrawal verification."

notFound: committee size and threshold in the mainnet election (looked for in system-config.go; the committee is the elected witness set read from the chain)

findings.finding: vsc.gateway holds 217,175.354 HIVE, 4,702.248 HBD and 3,866.117 HBD in savings; owner and active authorities are each 18 keys with weights 150, 149 (x10), 157, 153, 224, 298, 574, 966, 1632, 2237, 2417 summing to 10000 with threshold 6667.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: get_accounts vsc.gateway active.weight_threshold 6667, 18 key_auths

findings.finding: magi.network holds 544.629 HIVE and 18.724 HBD; vsc.network holds 5,379.292 HIVE and 57.026 HBD; both have threshold 1 with one account authority and one key in the active set.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: get_accounts

findings.finding: hivesmartcontracts pushed 2026-10-06; hivesmartcontracts-wiki 2026-07-10; outpost 2026-08-22; hive-engine 2026-06-22; steemsmartcontracts (the Steem-era fork) last pushed 2023-03-03.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: repository list with pushed_at

searches.reading: The organization lists go-vsc-node (Go, pushed 2026-10-08), utxo-mapping, account-mapping, sp1-helios-magi, zk-header-verifier, crosschain-sdk (HIVE, HBD and BTC swaps, targets Hive Keychain, PeakD and Ecency), altera-app, market-sdk, token-sdk; the older TypeScript vsc-node was last pushed 2025-01-21.

variables.q: hive-eth bridge OR hive wrapped HBD ERC20 contract

searches.reading: No first-party source for a deployed ERC-20 wrapper of HIVE or HBD on an EVM chain was found; CoinGecko has no HBD contract address and DeFiLlama lists no HBD asset. The EVM-facing work found is the Magi zk-light-client bridge repos, whose deployment on an EVM chain was not found.
A third-party summary reported a testnet marketplace initialised 2026-05-19 and a mainnet soft launch on 2025-03-31; only the FAQ above is first party for the launch date.
